eps.t: Cooking Up a Midlife Reset in Vietnam
eps.o: After a rough pandemic lockdown in Australia, a chef who's moved every year of his 40-year life changes careers in search of a midlife reset in Hoi An, Vietnam.

eps.t: A Bigger Life for Two Little Girls in Haarlem
eps.o: A family in the Chicagoland suburbs hits the reset button after a death in the family, motivating a move to create lasting memories for their two young daughters in Haarlem, Netherlands.

After his grandmother's passing, a hairstylist is ready for a fresh start with a new job in Amsterdam. He's looking for a place in nearby Hilversum that's modern and near the train station, but finding the outdoor space he wants may be a challenge.

After accepting a new job, a young couple looks to relocate to Landstuhl, Germany. She'll be studying at home and wants German charm at any price, but he prefers a place that's more practical and affordable with a short work commute.

An English family looks to leave comfort and routine for adventure in Levi, Finland. He's dreaming of a slopeside home in the wild, but with starting a new business, she wants to tighten the budget and prefers village life with a sense of community.

eps.t: London Out, Melbourne In, Cats Included
eps.o: A restless Londoner is ready to trade gray skies for a fresh start in sun-soaked Melbourne, Australia. He's looking for a two-bedroom apartment that's cat-friendly and near the city, but he may have to spend more to get the modern amenities he wants.

eps.t: An Encore Performance on the Coast of Pego, Spain
eps.o: Broadway professionals priced out of New York stage a second act in beautiful Pego, Spain. But between two cats, big Mediterranean dreams, and a desire for a more affordable life, they may not see eye to eye on this new production.

eps.t: Love,  Listings, and Maybe a Ring in Lisbon
eps.o: An unmarried long-distance couple takes the plunge and looks for a home together in Lisbon, Portugal. It's a test of whether they're ready for a bigger commitment, so their search may become more than just finding a house.

Fed up with Phoenix traffic, a couple seeks a slower life and heads to Barcelona, Spain. He's sold his endodontic practice and has retired to spend more time with their kids, and they're searching for Spanish charm, but it may come at a price.

eps.t: Up to Par: New Course in Dublin
eps.o: A golf-loving young woman leaves Chicago and her career for a new life in Dublin. Outgoing and eager to make friends, she's looking for a place that feels right, but her mom worries about her living abroad and alone for the first time.
